ballot-hint: Order the options you like, best first. Leave out any you do not want.
counting: The final result is being counted.
first-preferences-note: First preferences so far. The final result is counted when the poll ends.
no-winner: Nobody ranked an option, so there is no winner.
poll-ranked-hint: Voters rank the options and the winner is counted when the poll ends. Needs 3 to 6 options and a length.
submit-failed: Your ranking could not be saved. Try again.
